speaker: Assoc Prof Randolph Tan
text: asked	the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources whether there are schemes targeted for hawker stall operators and their workers to get temporary job placement or training when their hawker centres are closed for extended periods for repairs and renovation works.

speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: The centre will, among other services, provide information on training courses on the hawker trade.

speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: Hawkers and their hawker assistants who are interested in attending such courses may visit the centre to obtain more information.
